list.head: Background Information
list.item: Comments: This file shows that the contestant initiated a contest against the claimant for abandonment of the land and includes testimony with affidavits showing the claimant's improvements and intention of staying on the land. It includes the final decision by the court with appeal. Affidavit 1891-12-14 by entryman that he made final proof on 17 or 18 April 1890 and that since then he has not sold or transfered or offered to sell or transfer the homestead. Affidavit by James H. Crawford and Allen McNeill that the affidavit by entryman is true. Same affidavit by entryman 1891-10-26 and affidavit by Charles C. Beckwith and James H. Crawford that entryman's affidavit is true. Notice from Broken Bow Land Office that contested homestead claim is decided in favor of Henry K. Hamilton. Registered mail documents. Notice from Dept. of Interior that contest between George Diehl (sometimes spelled Deihl) alleging abandonment vs. Hamilton is affirmed in favor of Hamilton. Copies of pages and pages of testimony taken in hearing. Includes copies of registered letter envelopes and signed registry return receipts.
